headline: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench for AI agents interpreting routine wet-lab evidence
summary: OpenAI introduced BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark for AI systems interpreting raw wet-lab evidence such as gel images, microscopy, instrument exports and protocol records. OpenAI reports that GPT-6 Astra averaged 66.7% of available credit at its xhigh setting, versus 43.8% for GPT-5.6 Sol, across a provider-run evaluation of seven models and 37 settings. The announcement describes expert task review but also shows errors in interpreting controls, reconciling conflicting observations and counting colonies. These are first-party benchmark results; they do not establish dependable laboratory use or real-world research gains, and no independent reproduction was found in the inspected release.
